MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Band Perry appeals to me because country vocals and harmonies feel like a natural next step after The New Old Fashioned.",
    "Blown Away also fits my interest in country vocals, even though I would only choose one album this visit."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Daughtry and From Under The Cork Tree pull toward rock and pop punk when I currently want vocal harmonies.",
    "Crash My Party feels less suited to my mood because party-oriented country does not offer the same appeal as harmony-focused songs; simply being country is not enough.",
    "Tangled Up, ICON and PERCEPTION give me too little evidence of a connection to my listening for me to choose them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat a broad interest in accessible vocal music as interest in hits compilations, rock and piano pop.",
    "The country choices seem to assume that country vocals alone are enough, while the mood and emphasis on harmonies matter to me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The vocal harmonies I associate with The New Old Fashioned matter more to my current choice than a broad musical resemblance.",
    "My Christmas listening happened together much earlier; it does not necessarily mean I want holiday music or broad compilations now.",
    "I rarely choose something without a clear connection to my interests, and liking two suggestions does not mean I would try both during one visit."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in country vocals but stretched it beyond the harmonies and mood that make an album appealing to me right now."
}
